REPORT SECRET
Date January 29, 1933

Subject (in full) Russian Merchants & Manufacturers Association

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

The Russian Merchants and Manufacturers
Association was established in July 1932 with offices at
No. 799 Avenue Joffre.

Apart from the attempting to unify all local
Russian business men into an organization functioning in
the lines of a Chamber of Commerce, the Association
endeavours :-

1. To establish business relations with all local
and foreign commercial, industrial, financial
and government institutions.

2. To collect and compile various data of
interest to the members of the Association.

3. To organize juridical assistance, such
as (a) Arbitration and (b) Counsels for
legal cases and experts of every description.

4. To compile a Registry of commercial and
industrial enterprises and organizations
and to set up for this purpose an office
to be called "Bureau of Commercial
Information and Addresses."

The membership of the Association is open, subject to
the approval of the majority of the Board of Directors, to (a) all
Russian owners, partners, directors and managers of commercial
and industrial enterprises and firms; (b) Russian owners of
firms operated under a foreign flag; and (c) Russians occupying
responsible positions with foreign firms and institutions.

The style "Russian" applies to "all persons who were
born in Russia, regardless of their present nationality".

The entrance fee is $25.00 and annual subscription is

主题（全称） 俄罗斯商工协会

制作人 D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev） 转呈人 [签名]

俄罗斯商工协会成立于1932年7月，办公地点位于霞飞路799号。

除了试图将所有本地俄罗斯商人统一为一个按商会模式运作的组织外，该协会还致力于：

1. 与所有本地及外国的商业、工业、金融和政府机构建立业务关系。

2. 收集并汇编协会成员感兴趣的各种数据。

3. 组织法律援助，例如 (a) 仲裁和 (b) 为法律案件提供律师及各类型专家。

4. 编制工商企业及组织登记册，并为此设立一个名为“商业信息与地址局”的办事处。

协会的会员资格向以下人员开放，但须经董事会多数批准：(a) 所有工商企业和公司的俄罗斯业主、合伙人、董事和经理；(b) 在外籍旗帜下运营的公司的俄罗斯业主；以及 (c) 在外资公司和机构中担任重要职务的俄罗斯人。

“俄罗斯”一词适用于“所有出生于俄罗斯的人，无论其当前国籍如何”。

入会费为25.00美元，年会费为

Association. Of this number 60 persons became members of the
Association. According to our information there has been a
slight falling off in membership during the past six months.
While the exact data regarding the number of Russian commercial
enterprises in Shanghai are not available, it has been repeatedly
stated in the local Russian newspapers that there are about
550 to 600 Russian enterprises in the International Settlement
and the French Concession. Thus, even taking into consideration
that many of these enterprises are Russian only by name, it
would appear that the task of forming an authoritative body
unifying the majority of local Russian merchants etc. and
generally recognized as such, has yet to be accomplished.
However, even in its present state, and without
its authority being generally and officially recognized, the
Association may prove a useful source of information in all
cases where information is sought regarding the soundness of
a business or the reputation of a person in commercial circles.
The Russian Merchants & Manufacturers Association
is a purely business organization and does not take any interest
in politics. Among its members can be found Russian emigrants,
as well as Soviet citizens and former Soviet employees. Russian
emigrants, however, predominate. The Association has not, as
a body, any contact with the local Soviet institutions but
certain persons among its members are known to be in constant
business relations with the local branch of the Centrosojus.
Nothing is known in this office to the detriment of
either Mr. V.I. Korniloff, President of the Russian Merchants
& Manufacturers Association or Mr. V. Beliakov who is a paid
employee of the above organization. G. Prokofiev
Officer i/c Special Branch. D. S.

协会。其中60人成为协会会员。据我方掌握的信息，在过去六个月中，会员人数略有下降。虽然目前无法获得关于上海俄罗斯企业数量的确切数据，但本地俄罗斯报纸多次声称，在国际租界和法租界约有550至600家俄罗斯企业。因此，即使考虑到其中许多企业仅是名义上的俄罗斯企业，组建一个能统一大多数本地俄罗斯商人等、并被普遍认可为此类权威机构的任务，似乎尚未完成。
然而，即使在其目前的状态下，且其权威性未得到普遍和官方认可的情况下，该协会在寻求有关某家企业的稳健性或某人在商界声誉的信息时，仍可能证明是一个有用的信息来源。
俄罗斯商工协会是一个纯粹的商业组织，对政治不感兴趣。其成员中既有俄罗斯流亡者，也有苏联公民和前苏联雇员。不过，俄罗斯流亡者占多数。该协会作为一个整体，与当地苏联机构没有任何联系，但其成员中的某些人已知与中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）当地分支机构保持着持续的业务关系。
本办公室未掌握任何不利于俄罗斯商工协会主席 V.I. 科尔尼洛夫（V.I. Korniloff）先生或该组织受薪雇员 V. 别利亚科夫（V. Beliakov）先生的信息。 G. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别处主管警官。 D. S.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

CONFIDENTIEEL

No. 214

SHANGHAI, 20th January 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that on the 20th of July
1932 this Consulate General received a letter from the Russian
Merchants and Manufacturers Association whose temporary address
was then at 405 Ave. Joffre, announcing the establishment of their
organisation and sending me at the same time the regulations of
the Association.

A letter from this Consulate General, sent a few days after,
and asking for further particulars was never answered.

(1) F.O. 9186 (c)
(2) No record

I now hear that Messrs. B. Korniloff and V. Beliakov, resp.
president and secretary of the Association, whose address at
present appears to be at 779 Ave. Joffre, have approached the
local Netherlands' Chamber of Commerce, requesting it to bring
them into touch with Netherlands firms.

I would be much obliged to you, if you would inform me as
to whether you have any information about the above organisation
especially whether it is connected with local Soviet institutions,
and if not, whether anything is known from a police point of
view against the president and the secretary.

Any information you might be able to give me would be highly
appreciated.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

[Stamp/Text at bottom left:]
...ens, Esquire,
...ber 1/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

data.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

机密

第 214 号

上海，1933年1月20日。

先生：

谨此告知，本总领事馆于1932年7月20日收到俄罗斯商工协会的一封来信，该协会当时的临时地址位于霞飞路405号，信中宣布成立该组织，并同时寄送了协会章程。

本总领事馆在几天后发出了一封信，要求提供更多详情，但从未收到回复。

(1) F.O. 9186 (c)
(2) 无记录

现获悉，该协会主席 B. 科尔尼洛夫（B. Korniloff）和秘书 V. 别利亚科夫（V. Beliakov）（目前的地址似乎是霞飞路779号）已接触荷兰驻沪商会，请求协助其与荷兰公司建立联系。

如蒙告知阁下是否掌握上述组织的相关信息，特别是其是否与当地苏联机构有关联，若无关联，从警务角度而言，是否掌握对该协会主席和秘书不利的情况，我将不胜感激。

若能提供任何信息，我将深表谢意。

谨此奉复，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

[签名]
华务秘书。

[左下角印章/文字：]
...恩斯（...ens）先生，
...特别处主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

数据。
